title: Palace of the Dukes of Braganza
geometryBasis: Named OpenStreetMap palace relation with an exterior and courtyard ring, geotagged CC0 courtyard photograph, national heritage record, and measurements published by the HeritageCare palace survey team.
sectionBasis: The independent survey records a four-wing structure around a rectangular courtyard with a two-storey portico and 39 brick chimneys. Current CC0 photos show ashlar, pointed gallery arches, the lighter stone columns above, the lower tile lean-tos and brick chimneys above steep roof slopes.
limitations: The footprint and court are tied to the named map geometry. Roof ridges, tower heights, the arrangement of minor openings and the positions of chimneys outside the photographed court view are estimated.
The four wings, chapel projection, two-level courtyard galleries, and cylindrical brick chimneys are modeled externally. Interior collections, ornaments and the adjacent castle are outside scope.
